events.title: Scenario: AI compute growth pressures substation transformer capacity
events.summary: AI-driven compute growth may be shifting substation load envelopes and increasing near-term demand for large transmission transformers, creating procurement stress in regions with clustered data centers.

events.title: Scenario: Transformer manufacturing dependent on limited critical-mineral supply
events.summary: Transformer production depends on critical material and logistics availability; sustained input constraints would lengthen lead times and reallocate supply.

events.title: Scenario: EPC contractor capacity and skilled labor shortage delays substation projects
events.summary: EPC and skilled-labor shortages could delay substation and transmission projects, raising schedule and reliability risk even when equipment supply is adequate.

events.title: Scenario: Digital substation sensor rollouts increase integration complexity and cyber exposure
events.summary: Accelerated digital sensor adoption can improve visibility but may increase cyber and integration risk if standards and testing don't keep pace.

events.title: Scenario: Renewables variability drives short-term inverter and power-electronics demand
events.summary: Renewables growth could concentrate demand for inverters and power electronics, creating short-term procurement stress and potential schedule impacts for projects.

events.title: Scenario: Critical-mineral refining constraints propagate to power-equipment production
events.summary: Refining and processing constraints for critical minerals can limit power-equipment production and incentivize material-efficient designs or recycling, but transitions take time.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC corridor permitting delays shift demand to local reinforcements
events.summary: HVDC permitting delays could redirect reinforcement demand to local substation projects, concentrating equipment and labor needs regionally.

events.title: Scenario: On-site battery systems and microgrids increase demand for power electronics and procurement complexity
events.summary: Data-center resilience strategies using on-site batteries and microgrids could increase demand for power electronics, adding competition to utility and renewable procurement pipelines.

events.title: Scenario: Push for modular transformers and interoperability standards could reduce lead times if adopted
events.summary: Standardization and modular transformer approaches could lower lead times and installation complexity if industry and regulators align, but near-term impact is constrained by certification and retooling needs.

events.title: Scenario: Policy incentives for storage and resilience alter procurement priorities
events.summary: Policy-driven demand for storage and resilience can reallocate procurement and create concentrated supplier demand that interacts with existing supply constraints.
